outcome.reason: Customer used abusive language and is disputing the amount owed.

transcript.text: Hello, this is Shreya calling from Mumbai Bank. Am I speaking to Rahul?
Why do you people keep calling me every day? I've told you before, I'm not interested.
I understand. I'm just calling from Mumbai Bank regarding your account. Am I speaking to Rahul?
Yeah, it's Rahul. But I told you, stop calling me. I'm sick of this shit. Get your damn message.
Okay, I see you're frustrated. I'm just calling about your Mumbai Bank credit card - the payment is due. By when are you planning to pay?
Why the hell should I pay you idiots? You keep harassing me like this, I don't owe you shit! Fuck off!
